name: The Ruins of Ragnar!
author: moophyres
description:
Join us in testing The Ruins of Ragnar, a 2D auto-run platformer game which follows the adventures of Ragnar and his pursuit of power. We are in early production and are ready to test out the first 3 levels. Thank you for taking your time to test our game, and if you could, please leave your feedback.

Controls
Spacebar = Jump (can double jump, longer press for a longer jump)

Instructions / Goal 
Reach the end of the level (portals will be added in later)

Obstacles:

Ymir:
Section_1
Ice spikes will protrude from the ground, avoid colliding with them
Section_2
Icicles will fall from the ceiling, avoid colliding with them
Platforms without snow on them will increase your speed as long as you’re on them
Section_3
Traps from sections 1+2
Dark blue platforms will permanently increase your movement speed
Collide with the rune piece to unlock the next platforms to jump on
